environment.description: Same EKS 1.28 cluster but namespace 'devops-tools' has label pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted (Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' profile). Additionally, a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-privilege-escalation' with validationFailureAction: Enforce is applied matching all pods in the namespace. The container runs with a distroless base image (gcr.io/distroless/nodejs18-debian11). SecurityContext sets runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, capabilities drop ALL. No hostPath volumes permitted by the PSS restricted profile. Seccomp profile set to RuntimeDefault.

config.network_policy: default-deny-egress with allowlist for DNS (port 53) and internal API (port 443) only
